caption:
the free corner of a packed gym is still a gym

#gym #fitnessapp #soma

slides.text:
The gym was packed

So it rebuilt the session

Every rack taken

6:40pm on a Tuesday

One photo of the corner
that was free

Same targets

Rebuilt from dumbbells
and one bench

The plan isn't the machines

It's the work

slides.heading: Any gym is your gym
slides.body: Point the camera at whatever's free — SOMA builds the session from the equipment actually in front of you
